Name: Momo (Nikki Series) - Cat Replacer
Author: Gemaxis
Description:
This mod replaces the white cat pet with Momo from the Nikki dress-up game series.
this is my first time modding so jankiness might be expected, but I’ll try to fix/help as best as I can.

Notes to consider:[list]
[*]The sprite only works for the white cat breed.
[*]Hats currently don’t align properly with the sprite.
[*]Multiple white cats = Multiple momos! im still figuring out how to change this.
[/list]

Downloads.Description:
How to install:
﻿Make sure you have SMAPI and Content Patcher installed.
Unzip this mod folder into your Stardew Valley/Mods directory.
Launch the game using SMAPI.
